title: Win the Center Pawn
setup: Black has just pushed ...d5, offering a second center pawn to your e-pawn. Take the pawn Black has just offered.
hint: When you can take a central pawn for free, almost always do it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{exd5}} takes the offered center pawn. The natural {{Qxd5}} brings Black's queen out early, and {{Nc3}} hits it at once, a free developing move. If Black pushes {{e4}} instead, the knight steps aside and you are still a pawn up.

A center pawn is worth more than a wing pawn: when you can take one and keep it, do.
